help: Blitz Wallet for Telegram This bot is a remote control for the Wallet Connect account in your Blitz Wallet. Your money stays in Blitz; the bot never holds your funds or recovery phrase. /balance – Wallet Connect balance /receive amount [memo] – create an invoice, e.g. /receive 21000 coffee /send – pay an invoice (or just paste one) /transactions – recent activity /status – payments and invoices the bot is tracking /connect – connect or replace your wallet /disconnect – remove your wallet from this bot Request money in any chat: type my @username followed by an amount, e.g. 5000 pizza, and tap the result. Only the invoice is posted; your balance stays private. Stay safe • Blitz will never ask you for your connection string or PIN in a chat. • Only pay invoices you expected. The memo is written by whoever made the invoice. • To revoke access instantly, delete the connection in $t(paths.both).
paste_howto: Connect manually 1. In Blitz, open $t(paths.manage) or $t(paths.nostr), then tap Add connection. 2. Name it Telegram (use it only for this bot). 3. Permissions: Receive payments, Get Balance, Transactions, Lookup Invoice. Add Send payments only if you want to pay from Telegram. 4. Set a budget (e.g. a daily limit). Blitz enforces it, even if this bot were compromised. 5. Copy the connection string and paste it here. I delete the message as soon as I receive it. Telegram may still keep a copy on its servers, which is another reason to use a dedicated connection with a budget.

paths.manage: Blitz → Profile → Accounts → Wallet Connect → Manage Connections
paths.nostr: Blitz → Profile → Settings → Nostr → Wallet Connect

common.slow_down: Slow down a little and try again in a minute.
common.wallet_gone: Your wallet is no longer connected.
common.busy: The bot is busy right now. Please try again in a minute.
common.inflight_block_connect: A payment is still being confirmed. Please wait until it resolves (see /status) before changing your connection.
common.generic_error: Something went wrong on my side. Please try again.
common.unknown_command: I didn’t understand that. Send /help to see what I can do.
common.group_secret_warning: ⚠️ A wallet connection string was posted here. I deleted the message, but treat it as exposed: delete that connection in $t(paths.both).

wallet.trouble_busy: The bot is busy right now. Please try again in a minute.
wallet.trouble_timeout: Your wallet didn’t respond. Make sure Blitz has notifications enabled and the Telegram connection still exists in $t(paths.both).
wallet.trouble_refused: Your wallet refused this request. The connection may have been removed or lacks this permission. Use /connect to set it up again.
wallet.trouble_default: Your wallet couldn’t complete that request. Please try again later.

connect.relay_unsupported: That connection uses a relay this bot doesn’t support. Please create the connection in Blitz Wallet.
connect.invalid_string: That doesn’t look like a valid Blitz Wallet connection string. Copy it again from $t(paths.both).
connect.checking: Checking your wallet… (this can take a few seconds while Blitz wakes up)
connect.relay_unreachable: I couldn’t reach the wallet relay. Please try again in a minute.
connect.no_methods: This connection doesn’t allow anything the bot can do. Enable at least Get Balance or Receive payments in Blitz and try again.
connect.sending_off: Sending is off: also enable Lookup Invoice so I can confirm whether a payment went through.
connect.replaced: Your previous connection was replaced. Delete it in $t(paths.both) so it can’t be used anymore.
connect.choose_pin: Choose a 6-digit payment PIN. You’ll enter it on this keypad for every payment; it never appears in the chat.
connect.already_connected: A wallet is already connected here (switching wallets would redirect future incoming payments). To switch, use /disconnect first, then /connect again.

pairing.title: Connect your Blitz Wallet
pairing.body_with_budget: Tap the button on the phone where Blitz is installed and approve the request. The bot gets access to your Wallet Connect account (a separate balance) and, if you allow sending, a limit of {{budget}} sats per day. You can change or remove it any time in $t(paths.both).
pairing.body_no_budget: Tap the button on the phone where Blitz is installed and approve the request. The bot gets access to your Wallet Connect account (a separate balance). You can change or remove it any time in $t(paths.both).
pairing.no_secret: Nothing secret is shared: there is no connection string to copy.
pairing.link_info: This link works for {{minutes}} minutes. Open it on the phone where Blitz is installed:
pairing.approved_but_inflight: Blitz approved the connection, but a payment is still being confirmed, so I didn’t switch. Delete the new connection in $t(paths.both) and try /connect again later.
pairing.relay_unsupported: Your wallet asked to use a relay this bot doesn’t support, so I didn’t connect. Delete the new connection in $t(paths.both).
pairing.expired: The connection link expired. Send /connect for a new one.
pairing.no_budget_warning: ⚠️ No spending limit was configured for this connection: if you allow sending, Blitz will treat it as unlimited. Set a daily budget in Blitz if you want one.
pairing.check_hint: Approved in Blitz but no reply here? Tap “I’ve approved it”.
pairing.not_yet: Blitz hasn’t approved this link yet. Approve it in Blitz, then tap “I’ve approved it” again.

pin.cancel_setup: PIN setup cancelled. Sending stays off until a PIN is set: use /disconnect and connect again.
pin.weak: That PIN is too easy to guess (repeats, sequences, patterns or dates). Choose a different 6-digit PIN.
pin.repeat_prompt: Enter the same PIN again to confirm.
pin.mismatch: The PINs didn’t match. Choose a 6-digit PIN.
pin.set_done: 🔐 Payment PIN set. Paste a Lightning invoice any time to pay it.
pin.pay_prompt: Enter your PIN to pay {{amount}} sats.
pin.locked_try_later: Payments are locked after too many wrong PINs. Try again in {{duration}}.
pin.locked_nothing_sent: Payments are locked after too many wrong PINs. Nothing was sent.
pin.too_many_locked:
Too many wrong PINs. Payments are locked for {{duration}}. Nothing was sent.
Each further wrong PIN locks longer, and eventually turns sending off.
Forgot your PIN? Use /disconnect and connect again.
pin.wrong_remaining_one: Wrong PIN. 1 attempt left before payments are locked.
pin.wrong_remaining_other: Wrong PIN. {{count}} attempts left before payments are locked.
pin.disabled:
Too many wrong PINs. Sending is now off for this connection. Nothing was sent.
If this wasn’t you, delete the Telegram connection in Blitz now. To send again, use /disconnect and connect again.

send.paste_prompt: Paste the Lightning invoice you want to pay.
send.not_enabled: Sending isn’t enabled for this connection. In Blitz, create a connection with Send payments and Lookup Invoice enabled, then paste it here.
send.err_network: That invoice isn’t for Bitcoin mainnet.
send.err_no_amount: That invoice has no amount. Ask the recipient for an invoice with an amount.
send.err_expired: That invoice has expired (or is about to). Ask the recipient for a new one.
send.err_invalid: That doesn’t look like a valid Lightning invoice.
send.over_limit: That’s more than this bot allows per payment ({{max}} sats). Use the Blitz app for larger payments.
send.already_in_progress: A payment for this invoice is already in progress. Don’t pay it again — check /status.
send.confirm_warn: Only confirm if you expected this payment.
send.confirm_expired: This payment request has expired or was already handled. Paste the invoice again if you still want to pay it.
send.expired_nothing_sent: This payment request has expired or was already handled. Nothing was sent.
send.another_in_progress: Another payment is still in progress. Wait for it to finish (see /status).
send.another_in_progress_nothing_sent: Another payment is still in progress. Wait for it to finish (see /status). Nothing was sent.
send.conn_unusable: Your connection can’t be used anymore. Nothing was sent. Please /connect again.
send.sending: ⚡ Sending {{amount}} sats… Don’t pay this invoice again while this is in progress.
send.submit_unknown: ⚠️ I couldn’t confirm this payment yet. Don’t pay the invoice again. Check Blitz; I’ll message you when I know more.
send.unknown_first: ⏳ I couldn’t confirm the payment of {{amount}} sats yet. It may still go through. Don’t pay this invoice again. I’ll message you when it’s resolved; you can also check /status or the Blitz app.
send.unknown_giveup: ⚠️ The payment of {{amount}} sats is still unconfirmed after 3 days. Please check the Blitz app for its final status.
send.failed: ❌ The wallet reports the payment of {{amount}} sats failed. {{why}} Check Blitz before paying again — it may have gone through.
send.fail_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: This would exceed the budget you set for this connection in Blitz.
send.fail_INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: Your Wallet Connect account doesn’t have enough funds.
send.fail_RESTRICTED: This connection isn’t allowed to send payments.
send.fail_UNAUTHORIZED: The connection was removed in Blitz.
send.fail_RATE_LIMITED: The wallet is busy; try again in a moment.
send.fail_NOT_SENT: The wallet never received the request in time.
send.no_pin: Sending is off because this connection has no payment PIN. To turn it on, use /disconnect and connect again, then choose a PIN.

receive.not_enabled: Receiving isn’t enabled for this connection (enable Receive payments in Blitz and /connect again).
receive.open_cap: You already have {{max}} open invoices. Wait for them to be paid or expire (see /status).
receive.unusable: Your wallet returned an invoice I couldn’t verify, so I won’t show it. Please try again.
receive.amount_mismatch: Your wallet returned an invoice for a different amount, so I won’t show it. Please try again.
receive.created: Invoice for {{amount}} sats{{memo}}, expires in {{minutes}} min:

disconnect.inflight_warn: ⚠️ A payment is still unconfirmed; after disconnecting I can’t tell you how it ends — check Blitz.
disconnect.prompt: Disconnect your wallet? I’ll delete the connection and everything I stored about your payments and invoices.{{warn}}
disconnect.done: Disconnected. I deleted your connection and all related data. To fully revoke access, open $t(paths.both) and delete the Telegram connection. Until you do, that connection string still works.
